**> ### ALPHA RELEASE — Known Issues
>
> - Structure upgrades may take a few minutes to process — check the logs if something seems stuck
> - Structures do not yet clean up their associated entities when upgrading
> - If structures are not upgrading, try increasing your render distance
> - Use `/hbStructures getDetails` (no arguments) to inspect the nearest structure's current state
**

## Overview

**HB's Structures Over Time** is a Minecraft mod that allows structures to grow and evolve into other structures over the course of your game. This creates extremely dynamic worlds — where late-game structures don't appear until you're properly equipped, and where the world never feels cluttered by structures you aren't ready for yet.


## Why You Might Want This Mod

- Change modded structures into other modded structures over time, triggered by item or dimension-based conditions
- Restrict late-game structures from spawning until the player is later into the game
- Make certain structures only appear under special conditions — like at night

## Main Features - Optional Upgrade triggers

- Use the JSON config file (launch a new world or see me github file) to map certain structures and their progression plan

![Upgrade Structure Triggers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e39c4d702cf28136dfa83597247ec2a2c53c48a4_0.webp)

## Future Features

- Support for dimensions beyond the Overworld
- Cyclic upgrades — the final stage reverts back to the first
- Unique upgrades — a structure upgrades only once per world, making it a unique landmark

## Configuration

- The **JSON config** controls what structures upgrade and when
- The **TOML ** sets default values referenced by the JSON

Example configurations are on [GitHub](https://github.com/jhw2167/MCM_007_HBs-Structures-Time/tree/main/structureExamples).
